name: Building Plans
heroSubtitle: Professional building plans and architectural layouts designed to turn your ideas into practical spaces.
shortDescription: We help clients develop building plans and architectural layouts that support thoughtful space planning and project preparation.
fullDescription: TOP TECH provides building plan and architectural layout services for individuals, property owners and businesses. We help transform ideas and space requirements into organised building layouts that reflect the client's vision and intended use. Our focus is on practical space planning, clear presentation and carefully developed design concepts. Where projects require licensed architectural professionals, engineering input or statutory approval, the relevant qualified professionals must review and certify the plans.
deliverables: Digital Plan Files in Agreed Formats

faqs.question: What information do you need to start designing a building plan?
faqs.answer: Share your plot dimensions (or survey sketch), desired number of rooms/floors, intended use (residential, commercial, or mixed-use), and any reference styles you like.

faqs.question: Can plans be customized for irregular or compact plots?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every floor plan is drafted specifically to fit your plot boundaries, access road, and daylight orientation.

faqs.question: In what formats are final building drawings delivered?
faqs.answer: Final drawing sets are delivered as scaled, high-resolution PDF sheets ready for printing alongside CAD source files where agreed.
